text:
Maya: Found a slightly sad fiddle-leaf by the kitchenette. Free to a good desk. :seedling:
Jorge: Ooh can I rescue? I have a window seat. :eyes:
Maya: @Jorge it's small, will fit in your tote. FYI it smells faintly like last night's curry? :grimacing:
Sam: I'm claiming 'microwave aroma = mystery spice of the month' award. :trophy:
Elaine: Vote: plant goes to Jorge or to the office plant adoption lottery? react with :one: or :two:
Jorge: I'll take it if no one objects. I promise to water it weekly. :thumbsup:
DevBot: Reminder: please log plant custody in #desk-registry with `plant-name`, `owner`, `water-schedule`.
Maya: Also offering a pack of plant food sachets. First come first serve.
Sam: micropraise time — shoutout to Jorge for rescuing office flora. :clap: :sparkles:
Elaine: +1, and shoutout to Maya for the freebie. :heart:
Jorge: Naming poll: 'Leafy McWindow' vs 'Fernando' vs 'Deskweed'. Cast votes with emoji.
Sam: :one: Leafy McWindow
Maya: :two: Fernando
Elaine: :three: Deskweed
Jorge: Winner will receive honorary watering duties and possibly a tiny name tag. :seedling:
Maya: Also, quick PSA—whoever nuked fish in microwave yesterday, please own it. :joy:
Sam: Not me. :innocent:
Elaine: Noted. Let's keep the plant away from curry-scented zones. :shrug:
Jorge: Thanks everyone! Carrying it over now. :wave:
